review.tagline: Python OCR library for text detection and recognition in 80+ languages
review.summary: EasyOCR is a Python package that detects text regions with the CRAFT model and reads them with a CRNN recognizer, built on PyTorch. It returns bounding boxes, text and confidence scores from file paths, URLs, bytes or numpy arrays, and also has a CLI. Model weights download automatically per language, and it runs on GPU or CPU.
review.audience: Python developers adding OCR to apps or document pipelines
strengths: Two-line Python API returns boxes, text and confidence from paths, URLs, bytes or arrays
80+ languages across Latin, Chinese, Arabic, Devanagari and Cyrillic scripts
CPU-only mode via gpu=False; also ships a command-line tool
Documents custom recognition and CRAFT detection model training
weaknesses: Not every language combination works together in one Reader; English works with all
Handwritten text support is listed as upcoming, not available
Issues older than 6 months are auto-closed; maintainers cite limited resources
needs: Models: CRAFT detection, CRNN recognition (ResNet/VGG, LSTM, CTC)
